name: ClickHouse Cloud
description: ClickHouse's hosted server lists services and databases and runs read queries on ClickHouse Cloud.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.clickhouse.cloud) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
